title: Safe Pro Awarded New AI Subcontract and Launches “SPAI Ground Truth” for Next-Gen Ground Intelligence
summary: AVENTURA, Fla., Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Safe Pro Group Inc. (Nasdaq: SPAI) ("Safe Pro" or the "Company"), a developer of artificial intelligence
body_markdown:
Ground Truth is a 5-layer suite built on Safe Pro’s AI models that processed 3.1+ million drone images with 58,526 confirmed threat detections and mapped 39,777+ acres in Ukraine


AVENTURA, Fla., Oct. 08, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) — Safe Pro Group Inc. (Nasdaq: SPAI) (“Safe Pro” or the “Company”), a developer of artificial intelligence (AI)-enabled defense, security and situational-awareness solutions, today announced that it has been awarded a new U.S. Government subcontract and has launched **SPAI Ground Truth** (“GT”), an integrated software suite combining air and ground AI algorithms to provide next-generation situational awareness of the battlefield.


[Watch the SPAI Ground Truth illustration video here.](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=kxh6dzt2ZEasGy1WGEmfExNiqHSJwSb7KI7li-KGORjo4P7LOmDUGg_NjJzfManrqAG6tEqPqR0bT3R6gEWYDMdT1llbOHMRAx9tBdQVNvY=)


*Caption: Illustration of Safe Pro’s SPAI Ground Truth suite of solutions that fuses its air- and ground-based AI models with high-definition threat mapping capabilities designed to deliver rapid analysis and insights for enhanced decision-making on the modern battlefield*


**SPAI Ground Truth** consists of five (5) AI solutions designed to address the evolving autonomous battlefield, fusing sensor data collected from multiple sources including air and ground drones (unmanned ground vehicles or UGVs) to share real-time threat information on small objects such as anti-personnel cluster munitions and ambush drones.


“The new autonomous battlefield requires more than a drone or a UGV; operators need a reliable picture of the swiftly changing ground layer in front of them where perched ambush drones and IEDs could be hiding,” said Dan Erdberg, chairman and chief executive officer of Safe Pro Group Inc. “ **SPAI Ground Truth** is the result of over four years of operational usage and data collection including more than 3.1 million real-world drone images from Ukraine, designed to enable soldiers to true the ground with confidence.”


**SPAI Ground Truth** consists of:


**Component** **Deployment** **Capability**


GT Cloud AWS-hosted, scalable processing AI threat analysis and 2D/3D mapping


GT Air Embedded on Unmanned Aerial Systems (UAS) (drones) Real-time in-flight AI threat detection


GT Road Ground vehicles and UGVs Real-time AI detection of anti-vehicle mines while in motion


GT Field Laptops and tablets Real-time and post-flight AI detection in drone imagery and video


GT NODE Portable edge-compute server Fully offline post-flight AI detection and 2D/3D interactive threat mapping on the edge


The GT suite can identify more than 150 types of explosive threats and objects of interest, including landmines, cluster munitions, unexploded ordnance (UXO) and ambush drones. It produces 3D models, orthomosaics, digital surface models, and vegetation-height and terrain-slope layers with detected threats mapped onto them for maneuver operations. Outputs are designed to be shared over existing tactical networks including the ATAK/TAK ecosystem.


Additionally, Safe Pro was awarded an initial order from a new U.S. government prime contractor customer for its patented AI software in support of AI autonomy and threat detection capabilities. Additional terms of the contract were not provided.

**About Safe Pro Group Inc.**
Safe Pro Group Inc. (Nasdaq: SPAI) is a mission-driven technology company delivering AI-enabled security and defense solutions. Through cutting-edge platforms like SPAI Ground Truth, Safe Pro provides advanced situational awareness tools for defense, humanitarian, and homeland security applications globally. The Company is a leading provider of artificial intelligence (AI) solutions specializing in drone imagery processing and mapping, leveraging commercially available off-the-shelf drones with its proprietary machine learning and computer vision technology to enable rapid identification of explosive threats, providing a safer and more efficient alternative to traditional human-based analysis methods. Built on a cloud-based ecosystem and powered by Amazon Web Services (AWS), Safe Pro Group’s scalable platform targets multiple markets, including commercial, government, law enforcement, and humanitarian sectors where its Safe Pro AI software, Safe-Pro USA protective gear, and Airborne Response drone-based services can work in synergy to deliver safety and operational efficiency. For more information on Safe Pro Group Inc., please visit[https://safeprogroup.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=D2KvED678FT2BpqWr5tVcFx1F1L-yuOm0VioXjh2h4WdSZt_AnQust6Y87Fi5vgYRUPBXA_uaGbq_9N0LhFRfbdOoRZF-i7P8BMMOUMtXrE=) .
